en.answer: In that case, the effect does not resolve, and that <<11620>> remains in the Graveyard.
en.question: If <<9153>> is applied in a chain to the activation of the effect of <<11620>> to Special Summon itself, what happens with that <<11620>>?
en.title: If <<9153>> is applied in a chain to the activation of the effect of <<11620>> to Special Summon itself, what happens with that <<11620>>?

ja.answer: 「<<11620>>」の自身を特殊召喚する効果の処理時に「<<9153>>」が適用されている場合には、効果処理を適用する事はできず、その「<<11620>>」は墓地に残ったままとなります。
